jp: Death (instant death from Death spells etc.)
Idolized Sephiroth and became a SOLDIER for the Shinra Company. His blue eyes are the mark of one bathed in Mako. He is currently hired for gil by the anti-Shinra group AVALANCHE.
Clouds childhood friend and the star of Seventh Heaven in Sector 7. After the Nibelheim incident she locked part of her heart away.
Leader of AVALANCHE. He fights to protect the Planet. Rough but holds the group together. Still carries the past of his lost right arm.
A thoughtful beast who speaks human language. Rescued by Cloud. He is 48 but only about 15 in human years. Real name Nanaki.
Sells flowers in the ruined slums. As a survivor of the Ancients, she possesses a certain mysterious charm.
An airship pilot who never gave up his dream of space. After a failed rocket launch, Shinra cut off his space development funding, and he had no choice but to abandon that dream.
Ninja girl who loves materia. Travels with Cloud while trying to steal it.
A strange cat who loves fortune-telling and rides a Fat Mog. He remote-controls a fake body. A Shinra spy but not truly evil.
A man bound by guilt. His atonement is to sleep under the Shinra Mansion. A former Turk with remarkable gun skill.
Until five years ago he was a Shinra SOLDIER admired by everyone. After learning his birth secret in Nibelheim he became a ruler.
The Chocobo and Mog join forces to attack. There are two attacks: the bold body-slam "Special Move!!" and a transformation into the "Fat Chocobo".
She descends from the sky amid the Diamond Dust. The power of cold gathered at her fingertips freezes the enemy solid.
Ifrit, a being of fire, rises from the ground and gathers fiery power throughout his body. He then charges the enemies, dealing fire damage to all of them.
He raises the ground to store more lightning and holds his staff skyward, then discharges the gathered power at once to damage the enemy.
Raising a huge cloud of dust, he crawls out of the ground. Planting both hands firmly on the earth, he flips the ground over along with the enemies.
Appears riding a six-legged horse. Cuts the enemy in two with "Zantetsuken," and impales enemies who survive with the "Gungnir" spear thrown into the air.
A messenger of water appears from a sphere of water floating in the air. He calls up a huge tidal wave, dealing water damage to the enemy.
The black dragon Bahamut appears from between the clouds. He deals damage with the powerful breath attack "Mega Flare."
A red current envelops all enemies, followed by lightning, ice and fire attacks. Finally Kjata appears and sets off an earthquake aimed at the enemy.
A giant golem appears beneath the enemies and fires a beam from its eyes. It delivers the Holy-elemental "Divine Judgment" upon the enemy.
A ball of fire descends from the sky and the immortal bird Phoenix emerges from it. It attacks the enemy with "Rebirth Flame" and casts Life on the whole party.
Pulls the enemies and the ground up into the sky, then the red dragon Neo Bahamut blasts it all away with a powerful breath.
He chants a sinister spell over the black cauldron and engulfs the enemy in smoke that inflicts Poison, Confusion, Sleep, Silence, Mini, Frog, Slow and Paralysis.
Typhon, who has a face front and back, emerges from a tornado. He deals damage with two kinds of attack: a breath attack and a ceiling-drop attack.
The highest form of Bahamut. He concentrates power in outer space and breathes the mighty "Terra Flare" down upon the ground.
Thirteen knights slash the enemy in turn. Most enemies who take all thirteen hits meet their death.
